label: FreePBX 100 appliance
description: Sangoma FreePBX 100 purpose-built 1U PBX appliance running the FreePBX Distro, sized for 100 users / 60 concurrent calls, with three Gigabit RJ45 network ports plus a serial console. Mains powered, no PoE.
notes: Sangoma FreePBX Series datasheet (2025): FreePBX 100 = 100 users / 60 calls, 2 PCI Express slots, '3x GB Network / 1x Serial Console (RJ45) / 1x VGA', Intel Celeron quad-core, 4 GB RAM, 250 GB SSD, 1U with rack ears. Earlier FreePBX 100 revisions shipped five Gigabit ports - check the silkscreen before cabling a lab. Ports are eth0/eth1/eth2 in the FreePBX distro; typically one WAN-facing and one or two on the voice VLAN. The RJ45 serial console, VGA and the PCIe telephony card slots are not modelled (analog/PRI trunks are out of scope here). Asterisk + FreePBX web GUI/SSH management, so host + http-server + cli.
